summary: Voice v2 relay: a provider tool call where no tool is admissible (greeting, readback, public_web readback, no active turn) is now answered as refused to the provider, never exposed nor executed, and the session continues; more than 16 refusals per session stays fatal; provider output with no owning turn is dropped instead of ending the session; the greeting instruction forbids acting on earlier requests from the history.
reason: S24 18/10 13:09: the greeting saw a pending request in the loaded history, the model reached for a tool and the relay turned that model choice into a fatal protocol error, ending the live call before the owner spoke.
rollback: Revert this commit; such provider tool calls would again end the live session.

tests.name: voice relay suites
tests.evidence: test-voice-turn-protocol 26/26, test-run-web-voice 10/10, test-warm-v2-ownership ok, and the other voice and warm scripts (claw-live, warm, detach, cancellation, latency, M1 contracts/telemetry/disturbances, E3 surfaces, capability and owner admission, voice understanding 21/21) green.

capabilities.reason: Voice transport only; no tool is ever executed outside an admitted, transcribed turn.

architecture.reason: Same relay owner; provider anomalies are contained instead of propagated as client protocol faults.

limitations: Repeated warm prewarm closures (closed_before_ready, 118 occurrences in the retained companion logs) are not addressed here.
